title: One GPU's temperature creeps up 14C over 3 days at unchanged power and coolant temperature

expected.reason: No single reading crosses a limit yet (max ~80C < 87C), but the GPU runs ~14C hotter than its identical neighbour at the same power. The trend predicts throttling in ~1.5 days. Catches what a threshold-only rule misses.
keySignals: slope(gpu.temperature_c) > X C/day at stable power
coolant supply temp flat (rules out facility)

context.note: Telemetry is 30-minute means (labels.aggregation) because this is from the compressed-baseline store, not raw.
